summary: FortuneX Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing a First Amendment to its September 18, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with WT Realty Group Inc. and merger sub FortuneX Merger Sub Inc. Aggregate merger consideration to WT Realty stockholders was cut from 60,000,000 PubCo shares ($600,000,000 equity value) to 52,500,000 shares, equal to a $525,000,000 agreed equity value at the $10.00 reference price. Consideration remains fixed shares, with no net-debt, working capital, escrow, or purchase-price adjustments. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing date is disclosed. Watch redemption levels, dilution, and any further price resets.
